findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: packages/main/src/core/provider-process-registry.ts:592-600 inspects provider vocabulary only in a child-process call's first argument or a bare identifier's same-file initializer. Direct helper/property/computed executable launches such as function launch(command) { spawn(command); } launch('codex') and spawn(commands.reviewer) return false (confirmed with Bun), so packages/main/src/tasks/provider-execution-inventory-contract.ts:50-78 cannot enforce the promise in docs/requirements/decisions/managed-cross-provider-cli-execution.md:130-135 that every new provider spawn is classified. A new provider path can therefore bypass the mandatory shared-admission inventory without making the contract test fail.

packages/main/src/core/managed-review-evidence.ts:93-101 trusts an exact-subject importer commit when all paths are merely Story-local and at least one basename is review-passes.json or findings.json, while packages/main/src/core/auto-commit-metadata.ts:537-585 stages the entire Story directory. Pre-existing dirty checklist, scope-contract, or candidate-spec metadata can be swept into that trusted commit; packages/main/src/core/evidence-freshness.ts:137-164 excludes those paths from materialHash, so later imports and REVIEW consumption accept unreviewed acceptance/scope changes as receipt-safe lineage. Restrict trusted importer commits to exact importer-owned paths or reject pre-existing dirty Story metadata.

packages/main/src/core/managed-review-evidence.ts:470-560 validates only the currently inspected proposalFindingIndex and checks only that its ID occurs in importedIds; packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:1627-1709 enumerates evidence records still present and never proves the receipt's complete importedIds/index set remains present. After a multi-finding proposal is imported, deleting its high/critical member leaves a low member individually valid and lane-covering, and packages/main/src/core/machine.ts:789-858 then sees neither missing receipt evidence nor the blocker. REVIEW consumption must validate receipt-group completeness against the sealed proposal/import set.

packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:1851-1899 creates an ordinary durable Claude run's plaintext prompt in a random OS-temporary directory whose only removal is the worker-local finally at packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:2014-2062. A worker SIGKILL bypasses that finally. Reconciliation and GC call packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1316-1334, but that cleanup returns unless profile=managed_reviewer, so the ordinary random path is neither recorded nor recoverable and sensitive prompt plaintext can remain indefinitely. Use deterministic sealed run-owned custody for ordinary Claude prompts or persist a bounded cleanup handle.

packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:2008-2025 ignores the boolean result of cleanupManagedReviewScratchForSubmitFailure and always seals a pre-worker one-shot-input failure with replacementSafe=false. When cleanup succeeds, no worker/provider was launched and the former execution cannot write, yet status remains falsely unsafe; packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:3665-3677 then permanently retains the run because GC refuses cleanup/archival for that immutable terminal. Seal replacementSafe and cleanup facts from the actual cleanup result and cover the successful-cleanup input-failure branch.

readManifest.scanEscalationReason: Candidate cutoff tie requires a deterministic local corpus escalation so the final review receives an auditable complete candidate basis without provider document disclosure.
